tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Est-ce que tu aimes le café ?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. A tile like “une / –” means: choose! The dash means no article. A profession or nationality after être has no article (elle est médecin), but with c'est it does (c'est un ami). After ne … pas, un / une / des / du / de la become de (je n'ai pas de voiture).

Use the definite article (le, la, les) after aimer, détester, préférer: j'aime le café, j'aime les chats. Many places and transport words go without an article: en France, en bus, à Lyon. Then B asks question 2 and A answers. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Il faut un article ou pas ?
